title: Casco Bay Movers Dance Studio
specs: Portland Youth Dance offers scholarships and a pre-professional training program for ages 10-18
Proper dancewear and footwear required; dress code varies by dance style and age
Children should bring clean sneakers for Hip Hop parties
Birthday parties for up to 10 children in smaller studio, up to 14 in larger studio
includes: Set up and clean up for parties
gap: Age minimum for youth classes not stated
blurb: Casco Bay Movers offers dance classes for youth and adults, including a resident youth company with scholarships. They also host birthday parties with dance classes and crafts. Classes include ballet, jazz, tap, hip hop, modern, and contemporary styles.
extraNote: Weather cancellations posted on website, social media, TV channels 6,8,13, and voicemail · Make up classes for studio closures can be arranged · Paid-in-full tuition due by first class meeting, cash or check only · Registration fee $25 per student or $35 per family annually
